description: This file defines API function prototypes for managing IPv6 Rapid Deployment (IPv6rd) configurations within a data model. It includes function declarations for getting and setting parameters, validating changes, and managing IPv6rd interface entries.

methods.name: IPv6rd_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean parameter value for the IPv6rd object based on parameter name.

methods.name: IPv6rd_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves an unsigned long parameter value for the IPv6rd object based on parameter name.

methods.name: IPv6rd_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets a boolean parameter value for the IPv6rd object.

methods.name: IPv6rd_SetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Sets an unsigned long parameter value for the IPv6rd object.

methods.name: IPv6rd_Validate
methods.description: Validates the IPv6rd configuration parameters before applying changes.

methods.name: IPv6rd_Commit
methods.description: Commits the changes made to the IPv6rd configuration.

methods.name: IPv6rd_Rollback
methods.description: Reverts the IPv6rd configuration to the previous stable state.

methods.name: IPv6rdIF_GetEntryCount
methods.description: Returns the number of IPv6rd interface entries.

methods.name: IPv6rdIF_GetEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific IPv6rd interface entry by index.

methods.name: IPv6rdIF_AddEntry
methods.description: Adds a new IPv6rd interface entry.

methods.name: IPv6rdIF_DelEntry
methods.description: Deletes an IPv6rd interface entry by instance handle.

methods.name: IPv6rdIF_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Gets a boolean parameter value for a specific IPv6rd interface instance.

methods.name: IPv6rdIF_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Gets a string parameter value for a specific IPv6rd interface instance.

methods.name: IPv6rdIF_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Gets an unsigned long parameter value for a specific IPv6rd interface instance.

methods.name: IPv6rdIF_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets a boolean parameter value for a specific IPv6rd interface instance.

methods.name: IPv6rdIF_SetParamStringValue
methods.description: Sets a string parameter value for a specific IPv6rd interface instance.

methods.name: IPv6rdIF_SetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Sets an unsigned long parameter value for a specific IPv6rd interface instance.

methods.name: IPv6rdIF_Validate
methods.description: Validates the parameters of an IPv6rd interface instance before committing.

methods.name: IPv6rdIF_Commit
methods.description: Commits the changes to an IPv6rd interface instance.

methods.name: IPv6rdIF_Rollback
methods.description: Rolls back changes to an IPv6rd interface instance.
